Author: Glamour Pact contributors
Name: Glamour Pact
Punchline: Dom-controlled looks, local Synced Mods and opt-in strict controls.
Description: An opt-in Dom/Sub outfit library with named outfits, copyable macros, configurable glam locks, local Synced Looks and Customize+ profile/template choices. Shared Customize+ profiles require separate consent. Automatic styling pauses safely during transfers; helmet controls never edit weapons. Optional exact-Dom follow, looping pose locks and GPact Offline control; disabling the plugin remains the local exit. Update both players to 0.6.5 to stop repeated Offline saves and server requests on alternate characters while preserving responsive controls.
Changelog: Hotfix: stops an alternate-character mismatch from repeating the Offline transition every frame, rewriting unchanged configuration and sending duplicate Offline requests. Repeated no-op Offline actions no longer repeat those side effects. Automatic safety transitions preserve the registered character's Auto Online preference for the next login; pacts never transfer to alts. Temporary CC actor-gap recovery, responsive command delivery, four-second Offline-lock renewals, the 30-second fail-safe lease and 0.6.4 idle polling reductions are unchanged. Client-only update: no Worker, D1, SeitonSense or native-reference changes. Update both players.
